adjustment_policy: Store the Yahoo daily bar as returned, including adj_close. Do not treat adj_close as a point-in-time price. Phase 1 does not build features and does not send any series to Jev.
window_note: History starts 2020-05-01 so a five-year experiment window beginning 2021-10-01 still has a 52-week high and a 200-session average on its first decision day (~252 trading sessions of warm-up).
